en: A black and white postcard image depicting a serene waterside landscape with rocky shores and shrubbery in the foreground, a large body of water in the middle, and forested hills on the opposite side. There are a few buildings dotted along the shoreline and what appears to be a pier or a dock extending into the water. The text 'Gustafsberg' is clearly visible on the lower left side of the image.
